summary: Iter 32 — Realm Edit/Delete authz + cascade + audit log. Backend (pytest 15/15 PASS). Frontend (Playwright): founder/owner sees realm-edit-open chip, modal prepopulated, save flow works, backdrop click closes modal, non-admin tfone gets NO chip on /realms/dj AND 403 on direct DELETE, delete-confirm gated by exact-name match, full delete cascade flow OK, deleted realm 404s on direct nav. One UX miss: Esc key does NOT close the modal (no keydown handler in EditRealmModal.jsx). Audit log verified via direct Mongo: realm.update fields list (incl. updated_at), realm.delete summary present.

ui_bugs.issue: Esc key does not close the modal. There is no onKeyDown / useEffect keydown listener; only backdrop click and close button work. The review request explicitly calls out 'Esc closes modal' as a requirement.

action_items: Add Escape-key handler in /app/frontend/src/components/EditRealmModal.jsx (e.g. useEffect that listens window.keydown for 'Escape' → onClose) to satisfy the 'Esc closes modal' requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: Audit log on PATCH includes 'updated_at' in the fields list. Spec said 'only the changed keys' — auto-injected updated_at leaks into the audit field list. Cosmetic, not blocking.
RealmUpdate.privacy is validated inside the handler (returns 400) but is not a Pydantic Literal — pushing validation into the model would give consistent 422 behavior.
delete_realm summary uses -1 for partial-failure markers; consumers (frontend) treat any positive int as success — fine but worth a comment.
EditRealmModal.jsx is fine size-wise (~270 lines). No DRY violations spotted.
test_credentials: stealth/Password1$, tfone/pass1234, tftwo/pass1234 — all verified working.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed throwaway realms and self-clean via DELETE. Audit_log entries remain (by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PATCH/DELETE authz + cascade + audit are solid. Audit_log can be queried directly via Mongo (action='realm.update'|'realm.delete'). Only outstanding gap is Esc-to-close on EditRealmModal — trivial fix. All other regression items (bottom nav, /feed render, member view) confirmed.
rca of the issue: EditRealmModal.jsx defines onClick={onClose} on the backdrop and a close button, but has no window/document keydown listener for the Escape key. React modals require an explicit useEffect to bind 'keydown' on window and call onClose when event.key === 'Escape', followed by removeEventListener on cleanup. Fix is a ~6-line useEffect at the top of EditRealmModal.
